prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, early 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, long straight dark brown hair — wearing a skin-tight micro off-shoulder sailor uniform set, a cropped short-sleeve sailor blouse of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with a wide neckline resting low on her upper arms so that both shoulders and collarbones are bare, a navy sailor collar with two white lines lying open across her upper chest and a red ribbon bow at its center, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the modal jersey fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and a micro pleated skirt of ultra-thin matte navy modal jersey sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light and a small mole near her collarbone. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the open navy collar, the red ribbon bow and the bare line of her shoulders and collarbones, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy navy leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each longer than her middle finger, in navy lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a bold black graphic crease line drawn high above each eyelid, very thick false lashes on the top lids, small painted lash strokes beneath each lower lid, soft lilac-white eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, natural brows, a soft peachy-white lip.

Background: a bright tropical jungle boardwalk of wooden planks with a waist-high rope rail, large green leaves and standard-height steps, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
